metric_policy.coverage_at_error: in-sample maximum over confidence thresholds; not a deployed error guarantee
metric_policy.aurc: right-step integral over whole confidence groups
metric_policy.confident_error_rate: high-confidence errors divided by all questions
metric_policy.error_rate_at_0_9: errors divided by questions accepted at p_max >= 0.9
metric_policy.nll: exact from logits when recorded; otherwise from floored probabilities

readout: zero-shot next-token letter logits (SemIf prompt, chat template)
